notes: Sibling-record flagging technique from the author's 'find sibship records only in generation 1' section: PROC SORT by last name and temp id, then a first.-variable BY-group pass that increments a counter each time a new temp id appears under the same last name, followed by a merge back onto the original data to keep only flagged siblings. Original LIBNAME VA/AK pointed at private local matching data; replaced with a 10-row inline mock cohort (3 sibling families + 3 singleton families) shaped so the BY-group logic has real sibling groups to find. The undefined-dataset PROC FREQ DATA=CHECK fragment earlier in the same source file (CHECK is never created) was left out -- that's a script bug, not part of the technique being tested.
